verdict.rationale: Data portability and exit is a fair question for a SaaS/API platform like Plaid, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a first-party way to export all of a customer's data in open formats and leave. The transaction and identity APIs are the product's core function of pulling bank data into apps, not an account-level export or offboarding capability, so they do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
